description: Digital graphic of the flag of the United States: fifty white stars on a blue canton with thirteen alternating red and white stripes. Clean vector-style rendering with no text or additional imagery. Filename in the archive is GodBlessAmerica.png.

Post numbers 248590, 248629, 248746, 251626, 251705, 251731, 251826 and 252070; each post carries dozens of >>reply-link numbers.

SPLASH. FOX THREE. Q', and the move list of Capablanca vs Marshall 1918. A handwritten-style caption claims the Assange board position comes from that game and that the next move is 'White Queen to f3. Q Fox Three!!!!!' — presented as the collage's interpretation, not fact.

description: Screenshot of a tweet from the account Lynn de Rothschild (@LdeRothschild), dated 13 Jan 2018, criticizing the sitting president as 'a disgrace' compared with 'the good men who preceded him', with hashtags #VoteBlue2018 and #resist. It carries a four-photo grid: Bill Clinton hugging a man at a disaster scene, Barack Obama embracing a distraught woman, George W. Bush hugging a person amid debris, and Donald Trump tossing a roll of paper towels to a crowd in Puerto Rico (the 2017 Hurricane Maria relief visit). Shows 2 retweets and 6 likes.
text: Lynn de Rothschild. @LdeRothschild. Follow. If you ever forget what a disgrace now sits in the White House remember these moments from the good men who preceded him #VoteBlue2018 #resist. 8:28 PM - 13 Jan 2018. 2 Retweets 6 Likes.
flags: Tweet's characterization of the presidents is the author's opinion, not fact
Unidentified private individuals being comforted in the photos are left unnamed
